verdict.rationale: The pack never documents an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy, such as model or endpoint deprecation timelines or sunset notices. The only related signal is the `/openai/v1` path in the base URL. That is an incidental URL segment in the OpenAI-compatibility setup, not a documented versioning or deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
